title: Correction: ask for extract_text pattern examples
description: When a text extraction request lacks a clear pattern, ask for a sample source value and the expected extracted value.
planner_guidance: Ask for one or two examples before generating extract_text when the regex cannot be inferred safely.

example.question: What pattern should I extract? For example, from 'ABC-123', should the new value be 'ABC', '123', or 'ABC-123'?

rag_note: Prefer clarification over brittle regex guesses.
